Listeners acquired via Meta who save/follow/playlist-add feed Release Radar, Discover Weekly, Radio - the same algorithmic surfaces Discovery Mode buys into; practitioners explicitly pair Meta ads with playlisting so paid listeners trigger algorithmic pickup
Social graph: shares, comments, and UGC (TikTok/Reels using the track's official audio) amplify creative beyond paid reach; retargeting pools capture the spillover
Press/editorial coverage gives retargeting creative fresh angles and social proof, lowering CPC through higher engagement rates (which feed the auction's quality component)
